# oodle_genai_dataset_item (Resource)

One row of a GenAI dataset: an input, and optionally the output it is expected to produce.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One row of a dataset.
resource "oodle_genai_dataset_item" "password_reset" {
  dataset_name = oodle_genai_dataset.support_eval.name

  input           = jsonencode({ question = "How do I reset my password?" })
  expected_output = jsonencode({ answer = "Use the reset link on the login page." })

  metadata = jsonencode({
    reviewed_by = "support-eng"
  })
}

# Items are ordinary resources, so a whole dataset can be built from a
# list without repeating the block.
locals {
  cases = [
    {
      question = "Where are my invoices?"
      answer   = "Billing > Invoices in the sidebar."
    },
    {
      question = "How do I add a teammate?"
      answer   = "Settings > Members > Invite."
    },
  ]
}

resource "oodle_genai_dataset_item" "cases" {
  for_each = { for case in local.cases : case.question => case }

  dataset_name    = oodle_genai_dataset.support_eval.name
  input           = jsonencode({ question = each.value.question })
  expected_output = jsonencode({ answer = each.value.answer })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_name` (String) Name of the dataset this item belongs to. Moving an item between datasets forces replacement.
- `input` (String) JSON value given to the prompt under test. Use jsonencode() to build it.

### Optional

- `expected_output` (String) JSON value the output is compared against by evaluators that take a reference answer.
- `metadata` (String) JSON object of arbitrary metadata.
- `source_observation_id` (String) Observation within source_trace_id this item was captured from. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `source_trace_id` (String) Trace this item was captured from, if any. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `status` (String) Whether the item is used by runs. 'ACTIVE' or 'ARCHIVED'.

### Read-Only

- `dataset_id` (String) Server-assigned uuid of the parent dataset.
- `id` (String) ID of the dataset item.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Dataset items are imported by id.
terraform import oodle_genai_dataset_item.password_reset 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
